steer: Ok for mastering allyship flirtcraft and friendcraft I want to introduce a new feature. Essentially these games involve tracking a creature in the LL intersubjective space that players co-tend with the people they are in relationship with. The creatures are fed by metabolized charge and live in a garden made out of BarQuests. The game is to keep the relationship healthy. [...] Players can bring their own spirits to the collective garden but they are always co-tending their "fred" (definitely want another name). They can also tend to their projection of their partner AND their own concept of the Fred so they can see when what's being imagined is drifting. I'd like to have the 6 game masters weigh in with the design ontology to explore this more
